snippet.title: Max Payne Mods - Part 23: The Real World
snippet.description:
This is the first 'proper' release of The Real World, including The Construct, Dojo fight, Rooftop chase, and more!

This version includes:
- The Construct
- Kung fu Arena
- The Dojo
- Rooftop chase part 1
- A hidden level

🎮 Featured Title: The Real World
🏢 Developer: Maddieman
📅 Release Date: 2012
🏷️ Genre: Action, Third-Person Shooter, Total Conversion Mod
🔗 Steam Guide: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2630969589

Download link: 
https://www.moddb.com/mods/the-real-world/downloads/the-real-world-march-2012-demo

⚡ Complete no-commentary walkthrough and gameplay archive for Max Payne. Recorded in crisp 1080p at 60 FPS on PC with maximum archival fidelity.
